newsitems.title: Festivity OTS
newsitems.author: Morty
newsitems.contents: In this article, we’ll explain what OTS is, and how to test the Festivity event.What is OTS?OTS stands for Open Test Server. Here, you gain access to early versions of updates.This time, it is open for EU and RU players only.Your task is to provide feedback to help us identify and fix issues before the final release.On the OTS, your character will have the gear they had at the moment they were add...

newsitems.title: What’s behind the cards?
newsitems.author: Go
newsitems.contents: The personal store is back! Every stalker gets their own selection of randomly chosen discounted offers. Styles, charms, packs and more — you might just find exactly what you’ve been looking for! Head to the personal store and see what surprises are waiting for you.

newsitems.title: Join the Festivity on October 28!
newsitems.author: Vibeeeee
newsitems.contents: The hour draws nigh. Soon the fears shall step out of the shadows, and the horror born of sin shall demand its due. Only a little time remains until the Festivity begins.Until then, let the cards be read, before your eyes no longer recognize the written word.

newsitems.title: Fuss in the Bar
newsitems.author: CRIOS
newsitems.contents: The whole Bar was turned upside down when someone started a rumor about a backpack full of loot on the grounds of the Pervomaisky Factory. Many stalkers refuse to believe that such a haul could be right under their noses. No one paid any attention to the mysterious photograph left behind one of the tables at the bar... Don't hesitate — get to the stash first!

newsitems.title: Metropolite's arena
newsitems.author: Girodjet
newsitems.contents: The entity assumes its final form. Praise and embrace it.

newsitems.title: Diggers' Tales
newsitems.author: CRIOS
newsitems.contents: Diggers around the Scrapyard are spreading rumors that someone hid some loot nearby. The only thing is, no one remembers where the photo of the attic came from... Don’t miss your chance — find the stash!

newsitems.title: Camera on the Zone — you in the spotlight
newsitems.author: ванна красный пол
newsitems.contents: The Chernobyl Exclusion Zone is full of stories worthy of the big screen: wild firefights, epic moments, and unexpected twists. What if the whole STALZONE community got to see them? Coming soon: the #SZFRAGMENTS clip challenge! Film, edit, experiment, and turn your stories into something special! 📆 Kicking off October 28. There's still time to come up with an idea and get ready to chase those view...

newsitems.title: Chain of Decay — Rewards!
newsitems.author: Fitasuon
newsitems.contents: Today, we are rewarding everyone who actively took part in solving the mystery and completing the quest.Initially, we planned to reward only the players who stood out within the community, as well as the first player to complete the quest. However, we have now decided to revise our approach.In addition to the previously mentioned player categories, we have also added a reward for those who helped ...

newsitems.title: Server maintenance is completed
newsitems.author: Girodjet
newsitems.contents: Game servers are back online. Good luck hunting in the Zone!Respectfully,EXBO Team

newsitems.title: The rumors won’t die down
newsitems.author: psychosocial
newsitems.contents: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/dd5d7493014ce5da180dcec320b757ed6494579c.jpg More rumors are spreading through the Zone — supposedly, someone left a stash in Polesskoye. Who it could have been is unknown. One thing is clear: you need to hurry. Stalkers took several photos in Polesskoye, but for some reason, this one is the one that catches your eye... Don’t stand aside — beat the competition!

newsitems.title: Another wave of rumors
newsitems.author: Vibeeeee
newsitems.contents: You keep hearing stalkers discuss a strange loot stash on the Path of Fools. Without even realizing it, you have become the source of these rumors. You feel like you’ve already seen this stash before. A familiar image appears before your eyes... Head to the Path of Fools and uncover the truth!

newsitems.title: Unknown Find
newsitems.author: GoblinLootLord
newsitems.contents: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8c3613c9c456e7b9c05f0d682cdfad90f282a032.png The campfire chatter just won’t die down: someone has spread a rumor across the Zone that a bag of loot was stashed somewhere in the Black Willows. Shady dealers are only too happy to profit from gullible stalkers, selling photos of some garage... Are the rumors true? Check it out yourself.

newsitems.title: OTS closing
newsitems.author: oh_yeah
newsitems.contents: Testing is almost over! Please note that the OTS closes today at 20:59 (UTC), and before it closes, please take a moment to complete the survey sent to your in-game mailbox on the test server. You can discuss the updates in the feedback thread.

newsitems.title: OTS Survey
newsitems.author: psychosocial
newsitems.contents: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3676780afbe888889c42c83c22ac31d00891c09f.png All OTS testers have access to a survey covering the updated wide range detector animations, squad-based matchmaking, and inventory item locking. To participate in the survey, please open your in-game mail on the test server and select the "OTS survey" email. Thank you for participating in the testing!

newsitems.title: Mysterious Stash
newsitems.author: GoblinLootLord
newsitems.contents: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/db9fce37173cfd7bd9750e88dc7a474d904d3f4c.png Lately, stalkers have been constantly discussing a mysterious backpack full of loot somewhere on the grounds of the Kolos Agrocomplex. Deranged stalkers quietly clutch a photo of an old barn, as if it means something... Head to Kolos and put all doubts to rest!

newsitems.title: The art contest's submission deadline is approaching
newsitems.author: CRIOS
newsitems.contents: You still have time to submit your artwork! The deadline for applications is October 19, 20:59 UTC. Don't forget to include your nickname, the region you play on and a link to your submission file in high resolution, the access to it should be public!You can read more about the contest rules and rewards here.

newsitems.title: Nerves acting up? Keep your hands busy
newsitems.author: favlav
newsitems.contents: Meet Blabberbolt, a new bolt skin from the Aesthete Case V. For those who need to keep their hands busy while the Zone puts their nerves to the test. 👀 Blabberbolt comes in several variants, and we’ve rounded up the coolest ones in this video! Which one’s your favorite?
